## Derek's Rent & Work Recovery Fund | Derek Verbrugge
Source: https://derekverbrugge.com/donate.html

A Personal Fundraiser
Help me get
back on my feet.
I'm raising support through my GoFundMe to help cover rent
and the costs associated with getting through a difficult
work and recovery period.
Support the GoFundMe ↗
Read the Story
Derek's
fundraiser.
This is a dedicated page for my GoFundMe campaign.
The campaign itself contains the full story, updates,
fundraising progress, and current information.
Why I'm asking for help
In late August, I was injured during a dog-related incident
while working as a delivery driver. An MRI later identified
three compressed discs. I remain employed by my delivery
company, but medical restrictions have prevented me from
returning to my regular duties.
On September 16, my workers' compensation insurer denied
coverage for my back injury and wage-replacement benefits
for the days I missed. I am challenging those denials
through the New Hampshire Department of Labor. In the
meantime, medical restrictions have prevented me from
accepting some of the jobs I had lined up.
Just as I was trying to return to suitable work, my Volkswagen
Jetta suffered a major differential/transmission failure.
I now lack reliable transportation for medication access,
appointments, and employment. Before the failure, I had
already lined up temporary and part-time work.
Right now, this has left me in a very hard position. I'm
unable to find work, and I can't pay my rent or my bills.
Losing work after the attack was already a major setback,
and without a working car, it's been even harder to prepare
for and accept the work offers I am getting.
Every day this goes on, it gets harder to keep up and harder
to move forward.
Working toward a way forward
I am seeking the wage-replacement benefits I believe I am owed
through my workers' compensation proceedings. I have legal
assistance with aspects of my case, but the dispute remains
unresolved. I have also applied for Vocational Rehabilitation
to help me return to work within my medical restrictions.
Meanwhile, I am facing rent arrears and an ongoing housing
dispute following eviction-diversion efforts.
I'm asking for help with rent, essential bills, medication
access, and restoring dependable transportation while these
proceedings continue. My goal is to stabilize my housing
and health so I can pursue work that complies with my medical
restrictions rather than risk worsening my injuries.
Please consider helping
I need help as soon as possible. If you're able to donate,
any amount would help me keep a roof over my head and give
me a real chance to take the work that's in front of me.
If you can't donate, sharing this fundraiser would mean a lot
to me and could help me reach someone who can.
Thank you for your support.
Ways to
donate.
You can contribute through the GoFundME campaign or directly using Venmo, Cash App, or Chime.

Every contribution helps me keep up with rent and immediate bills.

## Derek Verbrugge | Digital Design, Marketing & Web Development
Source: https://derekverbrugge.com/

Marketing · Design · Development
Technical detail.
Visual craft.
I create clean, concise, and responsive digital
experiences that help communicate ideas clearly.
My work combines marketing strategy,
responsive mobile design, web development, and technical research.
Start a Project
View My Work
Selected
work.
Explore projects spanning web development,
digital design, simulation, software, and
fine art. I approach every project with an
emphasis on clear communication, thoughtful
visual design, technical accuracy, historical accuracy, and a
strong user experience.
WEB DEVELOPMENT
Websites & Digital Experiences
Responsive websites, front-end development,
and user-focused interfaces
designed for clarity and usability.
View on GitHub ↗
TRAIN SIM WORLD
Railway Design & Simulation
Custom locomotive and rolling-stock designs
demonstrating visual research, technical detail,
and digital content creation.
View Project History ↗
FLIGHTGEAR
Aircraft Design & Digital Assets
Aircraft liveries, model
refinement, reflections, and corrected model
normals for an Embraer E-Jet project.
View on GitHub ↗
SOFTWARE
Software & Technical Projects
Software development, quality testing, programming experiments,
and technical problem-solving.
View on GitHub ↗
FINE ART
Traditional & Digital Art
Realistic pencil art focused on observation,
proportion, composition, visual detail,
and disciplined craftsmanship.
View Artwork on ArtStation ↗
FIGMA
UI/UX & Figma Designs
Website designs, landing pages, UI/UX concepts,

View on Figma ↗
More Work
My design
philosophy.
Good design should make sense without explanation. I study marketing campaign
strategy and design with the goal of understanding
not only how something looks, but how it communicates,
guides attention, and encourages action.
Clean
Remove visual noise and focus attention on
the information and actions that matter.
Concise
Use clear messaging and purposeful content
rather than overwhelming the audience.
Fluid
Create layouts and interactions that adapt
naturally across devices and screen sizes.
Intuitive
Make navigation, information, and calls to
action easy to understand and use.
About Derek
Creative thinking
with a technical foundation.
I am a digital designer and software developer
with an interdisciplinary background spanning
marketing, graphic design, web development,
software engineering, digital content, simulation,
and traditional art.
I study marketing campaign strategies and design
to better understand how creative work connects
with audiences and business objectives. My
Computer Engineering studies give me a complementary
technical foundation for working with software,
websites, systems, and emerging technology.
I am particularly interested in projects where
strategy, design, technology, and communication
overlap. Whether you need help developing a website,
creating campaign assets, refining a brand, producing
digital content, or contributing technical expertise,
I am open to collaboration and project-based work.
Location
Manchester, New Hampshire
Education
Computer Engineering studies
Focus
Design · Marketing · Development
Have a project
in mind?
If you are looking for someone who can contribute
both creative and technical thinking, I would be
glad to hear about your project, your goals, and
what you need help building.
Discuss a Project

Software and Digital Assets
Flightgear
I contributed to the development of Gabriel Hernandez's E-Jets for FlightGear by producing
the exterior reflectmap for the model, correcting shapefile normals, and producing several
liveries for Fuji Dream Airlines and Helvetic Airways. The latest version of the models can
be downloaded from Gabriel's github
repository for free.
FlightGear
Helvetic Airways
FDA Blue
FDA Red
Forza
Forza
My Forza liveries are available for free in game under the gamertag kafovofa. They are produced
using the ingame editor and detailed reference photos. My top replica liveries
are featured here.
To Tip Lancia 037
Alitalia Lancia Stratos
John Harvey Holden Torana a9x
Holden Monaro Rally Car
Toyota Corolla SR5 Rally Car
